title: Water-fuelled microwave electrothermal thruster flown by Momentus

tellings.quote: Oh, the uh I invented the water uh based microwave electrothermal thruster. Really? And using water as fuel, and I got it working, and now it's flown in space successfully.

plain: A small rocket engine that runs on water, heating it with microwaves to make thrust, has flown in space and worked, according to the scientist John Brandenburg, who says he invented it. Brandenburg tells Michels he got the water-based thruster working himself and that it later flew on a space tug, a small craft that moves satellites around, built by a company called Momentus. If true, it would mean plain water can serve as a working spacecraft fuel.
